judged_text: The backfill INSERT bypasses the model's before_validation callback: raw setting values are stored as-is, so hosts saved with a protocol or path prefix (the old setting explicitly documented and accepted forms like 'http://discourse.org/1234' — see the removed embed_controller_spec fixtures) land in the host column unnormalized. Even once the cmd_tuples guard bug is fixed, every migrated host row containing 'http://' or a trailing path never matches `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)` in EmbeddableHost.record_for_host, so the migrated hosts silently fail to allow embedding while appearing in the admin UI as if configured; a later admin edit of such a row would also fail the validates_format_of regex since the protocol was never stripped.

adjudication.rationale: In the migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` values are inserted via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) rather than through `EmbeddableHost`, so the model’s `before_validation` normalization (stripping `http(s)://` and paths) is bypassed. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` later parses the referer URL and compares `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, which will not match rows stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`. This makes migrated hosts fail to allow embedding while appearing configured. Additionally, editing such rows later would hit `validates_format_of` which does not allow a protocol prefix.
